title: ENFERMEIRO - CENTRO CIRURGICO Salvador - BA Full-time employee
description:
Descrição da vaga

A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em situação de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.

A entidade conta com um perfil de serviços único no Brasil, distribuídos em 21 núcleos que prestam assistência à população de baixa renda nas áreas de Saúde, Assistência Social, Pesquisa Científica, Ensino em Saúde, Educação e na preservação e difusão da história de sua fundadora, Santa Dulce dos Pobres.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • 1. Responder pelo técnico de enfermagem, checando a distribuição diária da equipe e sua supervisão;
  • 2. Solicitar ao maqueiro o paciente, informando o nome completo, leito e enfermaria; admitindo-o na chegada ao centro cirúrgico, checando a pulseira de identificação (alergias); jejum; retirada de adornos e comorbidades), e a revisão o prontuário do paciente;
  • 3. Avaliar as condições gerais do paciente (vias aéreas, sinais vitais, drenos, sondas e cateteres, curativo cirúrgico);
  • 4. Informar-se sobre qualquer intercorrência ocorrida em sala cirúrgica, conhecendo drogas anestésicas e líquidos administrados, solicitando a presença do anestesista em qualquer intercorrência que o paciente apresente;
  • 5. Manter-se apta para atuar na ressuscitação cardiorrespiratória;
  • 6. Realizar sondagens se necessário conforme prescrição médica;
  • 7. Encaminhar o paciente para a unidade de destino, solicitando a avaliação do anestesiologista para alta do CRPA;
  • 8. Preencher a avaliação diária da lista de verificação (Protocolo de Cirurgia Segura), preencher anotação e registro de Enfermagem CRPA;
  • 9. Acionar o técnico do RX para exames de controle e transoperatório, supervisionando e auxiliando no posicionamento do paciente;
  • 10. Supervisionar a checagem da temperatura e umidade do serviço nas salas cirúrgicas e da temperatura da geladeira em anatomia e CRPA;
  • 11. Supervisão das atividades de manutenção realizadas no setor, e verificação do cronograma de manutenção;
  • 12. Supervisionar as técnicas de enfermagem durante a arrumação das salas cirúrgicas, CRPA e da equipe de higienização na desinfecção das macas;
  • 13. Realizar registro dos eventos ocorridos no plantão, e prestar assistência necessária a equipe multidisciplinar em caso de urgência/emergência;
  • 14. Checar o nível de oxigênio nos torpedos; testar o desfibrilador e verificar lacres de segurança dos carros de emergência;
  • 15. Prover uma sala cirúrgica para procedimentos de urgência;
  • 16. Lançar procedimento cirúrgico no sistema em caso de urgência/emergência;
  • 17. Verificação das peças anatômicas para serem emitidas corretamente;
  • 18. Preenchimento do mapa cirúrgico no quadro de procedimentos;
  • 19. Recebimento do mapa do banco de sangue, checar se têm rasuras.(Em caso de rasura não receber) e conferência do mesmo conforme o mapa cirúrgico;
  • 20. Confirmar internamento dos pacientes do mapa cirúrgico com a equipe do SPP; e justifica o cancelamento das cirurgias em formulário manual;
  • 21. Modificar o quadro de cirurgia do setor conforme mapa e turno cirúrgico;
  • Demais atividades:
    • Atuando no Recebimento do Paciente no Centro Curugico (conforme IT 03 )
    • Na Sala Cirugica (conforme IT 03)
    • No CRPA (conforme IT 03)

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Enfermagem com registro ativo no COREN;
  • Desejável que possua pós-graduação em Centro cirúrgico e/ou CME;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 44h;

Informações adicionais

Plano de Saúde Coparticipação - Promédica;

Vale Transporte;

Estacionamento Gratuito;

Seguro de Vida

Assistência Odontológica;

Refeitório;

A OSID – Obras Sociais Irmã Dulce é uma das maiores instituições filantrópicas do país, com cerca de 5,6 milhões de procedimentos ambulatoriais por ano, na Bahia, a usuários do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), idosos, pessoas com deficiência e com deformidades craniofaciais, pessoas em situação de rua, usuários de substâncias psicoativas e crianças e adolescentes em situação de risco social.

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why Join Us

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

As a Technical Support Engineer, you’ll solve complex, high-impact issues across diverse environments, ensuring seamless product performance and exceptional customer experience. You’ll act as a key link between customers and engineering, driving resolutions, sharing insights, and influencing product improvements. This role offers the opportunity to deepen expertise in Java, distributed systems, and troubleshooting while mentoring others and shaping best practices in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

What You Will Do

  • Diagnose and resolve advanced technical issues across multiple programming languages, build environments, and deployment scenarios;
  • Escalate critical issues to R&D with detailed technical analysis while maintaining transparent customer communication throughout resolution;
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive knowledge base of solutions, workarounds, and best practices;
  • Mentor L1/L2 engineers and conduct knowledge transfer sessions to elevate team capabilities;
  • Gather customer feedback on features and bugs and communicate insights to the product team.

MUST HAVES

  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles within software organizations;
  • Fluent in written and spoken English ;
  • Flexible to work in EU or US time zones;
  • Strong knowledge in Java 11+ (Java 17 preferred) ;
  • Basic knowledge of clustered environments, thread safety, data center scalability, and network protocols;
  • Good knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems ;
  • Experience with JIRA for issue tracking and project management;
  • Remote troubleshooting and system diagnostics across complex environments;
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills;
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities;
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams;
  • Ability to manage multiple products and technologies simultaneously;
  • Demonstrated curiosity and enthusiasm for staying current with industry trends;
  • Track record of self-directed learning and adapting to new technical environments.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands‑on experience developing Atlassian Server/DC apps using Atlassian SDK and Atlassian Plugin Framework;
  • Experience with Maven, Git/Bitbucket, and Bamboo build pipelines;
  • Experience with React, Node, and package managers;
  • Good knowledge of REST API design, JSON, and XML;
  • Good knowledge of Atlassian SAL, Active Objects, event handling, and licensing modules;
  • Comfortable with unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) and test automation;
  • Strong knowledge of logging frameworks (Log4j2) and dependency injection (Spring).

Perks and Benefits

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process

It includes main stages: Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Interview with the Hiring Manager(s). Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit. If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

  • 4+ years experience in software development

  • Significant practical experience with Java (4+ years)

  • Practical experience working with AWS, specifically AWS EMR (or ability to pick it up fast)

A BYD Auto é uma das empresas mais inovadoras e que mais crescem no mundo no setor de mobilidade sustentável. Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

You’ll influence the design of processes, pipelines, and analytics, driving efficiency and insight while collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of business strategy and technology, contributing directly to measurable impact and professional growth in a dynamic, collaborative culture.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Partner with stakeholders across departments to capture and validate business needs
  • Translate business concepts into structured technical requirements, use cases, and user stories
  • Define data and integration requirements in collaboration with architects
  • Map current- and future-state processes, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency
  • Maintain a clear traceability matrix linking business requests to delivered functionality
  • Work with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to clarify metric definitions, data transformations, and aggregation rules
  • Support efforts to standardize KPIs and enable self-service analytics using BI tools
  • Validate data outputs and ensure alignment with business definitions and governance standards
  • Collaborate with data governance leadership to ensure quality, compliance, and consistent usage of data assets
  • Assist in the design and implementation of new data pipelines, APIs, and system integrations across cloud environments
  • Partner with architects to document data lineage, source-to-target mappings, and system dependencies
  • Analyze and communicate technical constraints, data availability, and system impacts to business sponsors
  • Coordinate with engineering teams to perform user acceptance testing and validate results

MUST HAVES

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or Product Owner in data, IT, or digital transformation contexts
  • Strong ability to bridge business language and technical concepts
  • Knowledge of data systems, BPMN tools (e.g., Camunda), and integration frameworks (e.g., Boomi, APIs)
  • Strong understanding of AWS core services, including EC2, Lambda, S3, VPC, CloudFormation, API Gateway, and RDS
  • Experience writing detailed functional specifications, user stories, process diagrams, and acceptance criteria
  • Understanding of data modeling concepts, ETL pipelines, and BI/reporting workflows
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Collaborative approach in team settings spanning technical and business disciplines
  • Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries
  • Familiarity with Scrum/Agile practices, Jira/Confluence, and data catalog systems
  • Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries
  • Familiarity with Scrum/Agile practices, Jira, Confluence, and data catalog systems

PERKS AND BENEFITS

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 14.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

Sobre a vaga

A Gurilândia e Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Se você se identifica com essa missão e quer fazer parte do time, não deixe de se candidatar!

Responsabilidades

O que você fará:

  • Fazer o atendimento de todos que chegam na escola, sejam pais, alunos, colaboradores ou outros;
  • Orientar e direcionar pessoas internas e externas para os devidos ambientes na escola;
  • Atender ligações, fazer as devidas anotações e transferir ligações;
  • Responder dúvidas e perguntas gerais;
  • Auxiliar nas planilhas e controles do setor;
  • Ajudar nos eventos da escola.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Requisitos

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Se você tem coragem para abraçar novos desafios e está a fim de fazer a diferença, vamos juntos transformar o mercado de bebidas. Acesse nossas oportunidades! Seu brilho transforma a nossa estrela!

Missão do cargo

Responsável pela execução das estratégias (Fotografia de Sucesso) definidas para o canal e região nas suas lojas de atuação, garantindo a exposição e organização de nossos produtos nos clientes, assim como estabelecer um bom relacionamento, identificar novas oportunidades e atendimento com todos os stakeholders da loja, de modo a maximizar os negócios junto de seus clientes.

  • Realizar a ativação de todas as campanhas solicitadas com material de merchandising, racks, montagem de Materiais Permanentes etc.
  • Realizar pesquisas de avaliação na loja, a fim de promover melhorias ou reparar possíveis desacordos com a execução padrão da HEINEKEN BRASIL.
  • Realizar o preenchimento de relatórios da sua rotina.

Formação acadêmica

Ensino Médio Completo

Benefícios

Temos profundo Cuidado com a sua saúde! Oferecemos Assistência Médica , Odontológica , Telemedicina, Cartão Farmácia, Seguro de Vida e Previdência Privada.

Está precisando de apoio psicológico, orientação jurídica ou financeira? Temos o programa ‘Conta Comigo’ com profissionais especializados para te atender 24 horas por dia. E que tal pensar no seu bem-estar? Aproveite o Gympass para incluir atividades físicas na sua rotina. Sua família está crescendo? Temos o Programa de Gestantes desenvolvido com muito carinho para você! Além disso, temos licença maternidade de 180 dias e paternidade de até 30 dias.

Para te ajudar nas compras no mercado temos o Vale Alimentação* mensal e para sua alimentação diária temos o Vale Refeição ou Refeitório. E o deslocamento para a empresa? Oferecemos Vale Transporte ou fretado. Já pensou em comprar nossos produtos com desconto? Nós temos a Heistore , uma loja exclusiva para colaboradores.

Temos Paixão por aprender e pensando no seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos diversos cursos na nossa Universidade HEINEKEN , além de parcerias educacionais e programa de idiomas. E para desenvolver ainda mais a nossa liderança temos o Be Leader – um programa interno exclusivo que acontece anualmente para fomentar o aprendizado e a conexão do nosso time de Líderes.

NÓS SOMOS HEINEKEN!

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso time, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. Trabalhamos com marcas incríveis, que as pessoas amam, e com valores que direcionam um modelo de negócio vencedor. Acreditamos no nosso #timedeestrelase oferecemos um ambiente leve, informal e respeitoso para que todas as nossas pessoas se sintam confortáveis para ser quem são e, dessa forma, sejam protagonistas de suas carreiras. É assim que caminhamos diariamente em busca da realização do nosso sonho no Brasil: levar nossa estrela em cada coração e em cada copo brasileiro.

Para saber mais sobre o Grupo HEINEKEN Brasil e as nossas iniciativas em sustentabilidade, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão, entre outros temas, acesse nosso site.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.

Preferred Experience

• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‐end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‐like ecosystems.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.

We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.

This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.

The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).

Our Values

We're proud to share the values we live by. They're not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.

#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don't leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.

#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.

Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.

Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.

Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.

Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!

About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.

We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?

Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.
Skills & Qualifications:
  • Technical Expertise:
  • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
  • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
  • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
  • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
  • Problem-solving Ability:
  • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
  • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Communication Skills:
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
  • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
  • Organizational Skills:
  • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Experience:
  • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
  • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
  • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:
  • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
  • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
  • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.

Who You Are:

  • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
  • You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
  • Passion for helping others internally and externally
  • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
  • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

  • Vivência em ambientes com forte interação com clientes (B2B), incluindo negociação de escopo, prazos e expectativas.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas iniciativas simultaneamente sem perder visão de prioridade e impacto.
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para discutir soluções com engenharia, incluindo conceitos de APIs, integrações, frontend, backend e arquitetura.
  • Capacidade de realizar análises e consultas em bases de dados (SQL, MongoDB ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jira, Confluence ou equivalentes.
  • Excelente comunicação, com habilidade para transitar entre áreas técnicas, comerciais e operacionais.

Perfil que buscamos:

  • Pessoa com senso de responsabilidade sobre resultado, não apenas entrega.
  • Capacidade de puxar stakeholders e liderar discussões, sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Habilidade para tomar decisões em cenários de ambiguidade e pressão.
  • Visão sistêmica, entendendo impactos além do escopo imediato.
  • Equilíbrio entre pragmatismo (entregar) e qualidade (sustentar no longo prazo).
  • Organização e clareza para lidar com múltiplos clientes e frentes ao mesmo tempo.

Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência com integrações com adquirentes, gateways de pagamento, TEF ou sistemas fiscais.
  • Vivência com parceiros externos e integrações complexas (ex: redes, eventos, grandes operações).
  • Experiência com PDVs, ERP de varejo, soluções para food service ou eventos.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e capacidade de transformar entregas em aprendizados e oportunidades de evolução.

O que oferecemos:

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos com alto impacto no negócio e visibilidade interna.
  • Contato direto com grandes clientes e participação ativa na construção de soluções relevantes.
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e espaço para tomada de decisão.
  • Time técnico experiente e colaborativo.
  • Flexibilidade de atuação (remoto ou híbrido).

Mais informações:

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 59404

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

  • O profissional deve ter forte base em estatística aplicada a problemas do mundo real, domínio de Python e SQL, e experiência em feature engineering, validação e interpretação de modelos.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:

O Grupo Capital:

Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.

Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP no Brasil.

Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capital:

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.

Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.

Diferencial:

  • Certificação CFP, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.

Você terá:

  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

Modo de contratação:

  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital

Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Tech Systems Analyst
description:
We are looking for a strong Java Application Support Engineer to join our global Financial Services application support team, made up of team members in the United States, Brazil, and India. This position will sit remotely in Brazil. In this role, you will monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications. Relational Database experience with SQL, MySQL, Oracle SQL, or PL/SQL experience is preferred. Deployment experience using Jenkins is highly preferred. Our team works in an Agile Scrum environment with daily stand-ups and sprint meetings. You will be a part of an on-call rotation once you are trained on our applications.

Responsibilities:

  • Java application support
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications
  • Debug software components, identify, fix, and verify remediation of code defects (own work and the work of others)
  • Support and maintain projects developed by the team and assist in production deployment and outages
  • Configure, deploy, debug, monitor, and document new system features and enhancements using Jenkins
  • Successfully communicate designs, research, and potential issues with team members
  • Collaborate with business professionals to determine functional and non-functional requirements for software development projects.
  • Participate in rotational 24x7 on-call 3rd/4th level support

Qualifications:

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 4+ Years of Java/J2EE application support experience
  • 2+ years of Relational Database experience
  • 2+ years of CI/CD tools (Jenkins)
  • 2+ years of experience on Linux platform
  • Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design principles
  • Knowledge of the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Git, Maven, Jenkins, JIRA)
  • Excellent organizational skills, self-administration, attention to detail, multi-tasking, and effective prioritization
  • Strong interpersonal and English communication skills
  • Self-motivated and able to meet objectives
  • Experience with the following technologies preferred:
  • Spring/Spring-MVC/Spring Batch/Spring Boot is a plus
  • Tomcat, JBoss
  • REST Services, SOAP Services
  • Relational Database experience
  • JIRA & Confluence
  • Dynatrace & Splunk

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Duration: 6months

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions
  • Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows
  • Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights
  • Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes
  • Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring
  • Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
  • Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
  • Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
  • Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
  • Flow Builder (must-have)
  • Reports & Dashboards
  • Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
  • Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
  • Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules)
  • Experience with data quality and governance
  • Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level)
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills

Primary Skills

1.Salesforce Platform hands-on experience

2.Salesforce admin expertise (Security Model, Data Model, End to End configuration, Flows etc)

3. Salesforce Admin Cert

4. Reports & Dashboards – Handson

Secondary Skills

1. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud

2. Business analysis

3. Stakeholder Management

title: Analista de infraestrutura Junior - Linux
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Responsável por fornecer suporte técnico na configuração, manutenção e monitoramento de servidores, a fim de garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos sistemas e recursos de infraestrutura.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Instala servidores físicos ou virtuais, garantindo a configuração adequada dos sistemas operacionais e softwares relacionados;
  • Suporte de serviços de rede essenciais nos servidores, como DHCP, DNS, Controladores de Domínios, servidores de arquivos e impressão, para garantir a conectividade e a disponibilidade dos recursos de rede;
  • Realiza a manutenção regular dos servidores, aplicando atualizações de segurança, patches e correções de bugs para garantir a estabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas.
  • Presta suporte técnico aos usuários, solucionando problemas relacionados aos servidores, respondendo a solicitações de suporte e fornecendo orientações sobre o uso adequado dos recursos disponíveis;
  • Colabora em projetos de infraestrutura de servidores, auxiliando na implementação de novas tecnologias, migrações ou atualizações de servidores;
  • Mantém a documentação atualizada dos servidores, registrando configurações, alterações e procedimentos relevantes para referência futura e garantindo a consistência nas operações;
  • Mantém-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços tecnológicos relacionados à infraestrutura de servidores, buscando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização dos sistemas;
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis, como reuniões de planejamento, retrospectivas e revisões, compartilhando informações sobre a infraestrutura de servidores e colaborando para a melhoria contínua do squad ágil.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada (desejável). ●

Conhecimentos:

  • Windows Server: Configuração e administração de servidores Windows, incluindo Active Directory, DHCP, DNS e funções de servidor.
  • Linux: Conhecimentos básicos de administração de sistemas Linux, gerenciamento de pacotes e comandos do shell.
  • Backup: Familiaridade com estratégias e ferramentas de backup, para garantir a proteção e recuperação de dados.
  • Redes: Compreensão dos conceitos básicos de redes, protocolos (TCP/IP) e configuração de dispositivos de rede.
  • Administração de servidores: Gerenciamento de servidores físicos e virtuais, incluindo instalação e configuração.
  • Virtualização: Conhecimento em tecnologias de virtualização como VMware ou Hyper-V.
  • Armazenamento: Noções sobre armazenamento de dados, RAID e tecnologias de armazenamento em rede (NAS e SAN).
  • Segurança da informação: Conhecimentos básicos de práticas de segurança cibernética e controle de acesso.
  • Monitoramento e resolução de problemas: Utilização de ferramentas de monitoramento para detectar e solucionar problemas de infraestrutura.
  • Automação e scripting: Habilidades básicas de automação usando scripts como PowerShell ou Shell Script.
  • Resolução de problemas: Capacidade de analisar e solucionar questões relacionadas à infraestrutura de TI.
  • Certificações relevantes em infraestrutura de servidores, como Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC), entre outras. (desejável)

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Senior API Engineer (NodeJS, TS, SDUI)
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world's most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.

Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You'll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.

Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English

Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.

Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.

Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Operations Support | AI-First | Remote (LATAM)

Salary - USD $18,000 – $21,000/year DOE + Monthly Health Insurance Bonus (~$100/mo)

Schedule - Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:30 PM EST

PTO - 10 days/year (accrual) | U.S. Holidays Off

Payments - Bi-weekly

Location - Remote — Latin America

This isn't an assistant role where you wait to be told what to do.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it's uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn't the right fit. If you're the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.

About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn't optional here. It's embedded in how we work.

We're building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That's what this role is.

About the Role

You'll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a "take notes and schedule meetings" role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what's falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren't getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.

The Director will be the first to tell you: he's a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn't afraid to say "Hey, this still isn't done and it needs to be." If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.

You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.

What Makes You Different

We've titled this section intentionally. We're not looking for a generic set of skills—we're looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:

  • You're a Self-Starter. You don't wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don't ask "Should I do this?"—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they're communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you're checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they'd send an invoice, you're following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You're not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he'd review something and hasn't, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn't confrontation—it's how things actually get done.
  • You're Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don't let things slide because it's easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You're the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You're Committed to Your Own Growth. You're not just looking for a job—you're looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.

A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can't wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won't be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who's willing to engage. It's a two-way street built on mutual respect.

Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director's task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what's overdue
  • Serve as the "closing engine" that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director's calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed

Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren't aspirational posters on a wall. They're how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:

  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You're constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday's process is tomorrow's improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You're honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you're in, you're fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.

Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems

Who Thrives in This Role

You thrive here if you're the person who:

• Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

• Constantly asks: "How can this be automated or improved?"

• Has been told "You're more organized than my actual manager"

• Isn't intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

• Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

• Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball

What's in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development

One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought "That's me"—we want to hear from you. We'd rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

title: Arquiteto de soluções SAP
description:
Oportunidade de Carreira: Arquiteto de Soluções SAP no Grupo LPJ

Sobre o Grupo LPJ:

Com 20 anos de história, o Grupo LPJ é uma holding de consultorias com soluções especializadas em estratégia de negócios, sistemas SAP, gestão de processos, tecnologia e compliance tributário. Formado por empresas com expertise complementar, o grupo é parceiro de grandes marcas e reconhecido por entregar resultados consistentes, com inovação, agilidade e foco em pessoas. Aqui, acreditamos que o nosso maior diferencial está no talento e na dedicação dos nossos times.

As empresas BASE e SOURCE são especialistas em soluções SAP. Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. Com forte atuação em tecnologia, gestão de processos e metodologias ágeis, são ambientes ideais para quem busca crescimento técnico e novos desafios em projetos estratégicos.

Sobre o perfil:

Como Arquiteto de Soluções SAP, será responsável por compreender demandas de negócio e traduzi-las em propostas técnicas e comerciais robustas, viáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da organização. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Entendimento de demanda: Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;
  • Desenho de soluções SAP: Modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, entre outras) com autonomia, considerando inovação, viabilidade técnica e custo-benefício;
  • Documentação estratégica: Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
  • Integração interfuncional: Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
  • Elaboração da proposta final: Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
  • Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
  • Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, entre outras);
  • Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e LeanIX;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
  • Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
  • Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
  • Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + ServiceNow);

Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!

Clinical Research Associate (Oncology) – São Paulo (0.4 FTE, Rescue Study)

We are seeking an experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to support a Phase 2 oncology rescue study in solid tumors. The role is part‐time (0.4 FTE) and based in São Paulo, with on‐site visits to the study site every 6–8 weeks.

  • 1 year contract
  • Start date: ASAP

  • Perform regular on‐site monitoring visits approximately every 6–8 weeks
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data quality, and patient safety in a rescue study setting
  • Complete source data verification and support data clean‐up and query resolution
  • Review and maintain essential documents and site files
  • Collaborate closely with site staff and the project team to address study issues and implement corrective actions as needed

  • 4–5 years of experience as a CRA
  • Proven experience monitoring oncology clinical trials, ideally in solid tumors

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

- Review customer invoicing

- Review vendor bills and submit payments

- Approve and submit payroll

- Perform P&L scrubs

- Review cash flow forecasts

- Resolve collections issues

- Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

- Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

- Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

- Perform source document filing spot checks

- Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

- Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

- Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

- Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

- Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

- Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,

graphs, and footnotes

- Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

- Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

- Complete 941 reconciliations

- Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

- Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

- Review the chart of accounts

- Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

- Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

- Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

- Review new client’s current process and procedural documents

- Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

- Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

- Delegate updates to Staff Accountant


Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules 9am to 5pm EST


Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 3,000–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.


We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Customer Success Associate

AdManage.Ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & TikTok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50M+ in ad spend, our mission is to level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.

Our platform launches 900,000+ ads per month, saving advertisers hours with bulk ad creation, creative mining, and AI-powered campaign tools. We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience — not just ideas.


The Mission Our users are ambitious brands and agencies who rely on us not just for software, but for expertise that helps them scale profitably. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Junior Customer Success Manager with a media buying background who can bridge the gap between software and performance marketing. You'll ensure our customers get real outcomes with AdManage.Ai — not just features. You'll be supported by a strong CS team and learn fast.

  • Prior internship or junior role at a startup or agency

Why Join Us
